_comment: Production 2026-10-03: StatusOS with lMsg=true on OS 38, whose RPS 17 the Ribeirão Preto city hall rejected five times on 02/10. One block per send attempt, newest first; inside a block, newest first too: the ERRO lines, then "Envio do RPS 17 retornou erros.", then "Enviando o RPS 17 no Lote ...". The 17:30 attempt has no EM062. Captured through the connector (after the 0.9.2 transform). CNPJ, municipal registration and order number anonymized.
